description: Design and write property-based tests (Hypothesis for Python, proptest for Rust, same ideas for fast-check/QuickCheck): choose properties (round-trip, oracle, invariant, idempotence, metamorphic, model-based), build generators that hit real input space, read shrunk counterexamples, pin regressions, and keep runs deterministic in CI. Use when a function has a large input space, parsers/serializers/codecs, normalizers, data-structure invariants, or stateful APIs that example-based tests keep missing. Do NOT use for coverage-guided byte-level crash hunting (see fuzz-testing), judging test-suite strength (mutation-testing), or ordinary example tests (unit-testing).
